feedback_channel: Official CurseForge project pages; no issuesUrl/sourceUrl is declared by these projects. Do not report Bedrock defects to the Java author by guessing a repository.
feedback_policy: Send only a minimal reproduction on the latest unmodified author release, with engine/client version and pack order. Existing historical client logs are not a current reproduction.
resolved_in_latest: Immersive Eating 1.0 contains variable.melee_spear_equipped initialization; the older accumulated log is not evidence of a current missing initializer.
